chapter.heading: A Song or Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
O God,
my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

Awake, psaltery
and harp: I myself will awake early.

I will
praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

For thy
mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

Be thou
exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

That thy
beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

God hath
spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

Gilead is
mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

Moab is
my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

Who will
bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

Wilt not
thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

Give us
help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

Through God
we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
